business_problem: League needed to accelerate product development and internal operations in a regulated healthcare environment, but prompt tuning, multi-agent experimentation, and back-office work still required manual effort and strict security controls.
solution_summary: League standardized on Claude Enterprise and Claude Code to make agentic work safe enough for a regulated healthcare software company. Engineers use Claude through an internal Swarm orchestration layer that can run up to 50 parallel agents against real build tasks, write code, run tests, and open pull requests, while engineers review every change before it ships. For a critical prompt-optimization workflow, League paired Fable exploration with Claude Code implementation across four codebases and two languages so a failing agent can read evaluation scores and rewrite its own prompt automatically. The rollout also extends beyond engineering: finance automates month-end, quarter-end, and payroll workflows, and teams use Claude Design for branded decks. Claude Security controls model tiers, connectors, and usage boundaries across the company.
